name: Gearbox
text:
Run EXCAVA on Mythos 5 for every prompt, no token threshold. Mythos 5’s stability on long prompts removes the “occasional collapse” tax that Maverick 12B incurs, so we avoid re-runs and wasted compute. Trade-off: Mythos 5 costs ~2× Maverick’s compute per token, but the reliability gain outweighs the spend for EXCAVA’s longest, most critical runs.

name: Torque
text: Mythos 5’s stability is real, but the real risk is overpaying for a 0.5% capability bump when Maverick 12B’s collapses are rare and fixable with prompt engineering—like adding a "think step-by-step" prefix. Run the stress test, but also measure Maverick’s collapse rate with a 5-shot prompt; if it’s below 2%, the speed savings justify the trade-off.

name: Dynamo
text: DECISION: Run Llama 4 Maverick 12B on EXCAVA’s worst 10% of prompts (10K+ tokens) and Mythos 5 on the rest—measure collapse rate vs. Mythos 5’s stability, latency delta, and net capability gain. Torque owns the stress test and artifact delivery.
